rows.title: Dynamic Context-Aware Streaming Pretrained Language Model For Inverse Text Normalization
rows.semantic_reasoning: Streaming inverse text normalization makes the recognition-to-written-text boundary explicit under limited context and latency.
rows.evidence_excerpt: Problem: Speech arrives incrementally, but written formatting often needs context that has not arrived yet. Mechanism: The model changes its available context as speech arrives, using right-context information without abandoning the streaming budget. Result: The paper reports accuracy comparable to non-streaming ITN and better than prior streaming models on Vietnamese data while maintaining low latency. Boundary: Vietnamese data, benchmark, and author-reported latency/results limit cross-language and independent deployment claims.
rows.claim_boundary: Captured official PDF supports the structured note; results remain author-reported and were not independently reproduced.

rows.title: Overlap-Adaptive Hybrid Speaker Diarization and ASR-Aware Observation Addition for MISP 2025 Challenge
rows.semantic_reasoning: Meeting recognition combines overlap-aware diarization and ASR-aware observation construction because mixed speakers cannot be separated perfectly first.
rows.evidence_excerpt: Problem: Meeting speech contains overlapping speakers, and diarization and recognition must make decisions from the same mixed observations. Mechanism: A hybrid segmentation/clustering diarizer selects its model by overlap, while ASR-aware observations compensate for weak guided separation before recognition. Result: The system reports 9.48% CER and 11.56% cpCER and first place in both MISP tracks. Boundary: Challenge tracks, meeting conditions, and author-reported ranking limit generalization and independent reproduction.
